boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten documented NJIT settings for quiet reading, computer work, data projects, design research, and collaborative sessions.

cards.title: Robert W. Van Houten Library
cards.subtitle: Central Avenue Building
cards.notes: Choose a seat for independent reading or meet classmates at a table; the library supports individual and group study and provides wireless access throughout.
cards.short_summary: A full-service university library with varied seating for research, computing, browsing, and study.
cards.evidence_claim: NJIT identifies Van Houten Library as a facility for individual and group study, research, computing, and browsing, with wireless access throughout.
cards.source_title: About Us | Robert W. Van Houten Library
cards.access_notes: The library primarily supports the NJIT community; members of the public may use it for research relating to its unique science and technology collection and may need ID.

cards.title: Information Commons
cards.subtitle: Robert W. Van Houten Library, Central Avenue Building
cards.notes: Use a campus workstation when your work needs library-based computing; bring headphones and save files to your preferred cloud or storage location.
cards.short_summary: A computer-lab study setting inside Van Houten Library.
cards.evidence_claim: NJIT states that the Information Commons in Van Houten Library is a computer lab with more than 100 workstations.
cards.access_notes: Located in Van Houten Library; check the library’s current hours and workstation availability before visiting.

cards.entity_name: Van Houten Library Group Study Rooms
cards.title: Van Houten Library Group Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Robert W. Van Houten Library, Central Avenue Building
cards.notes: Reserve a room for a project meeting or shared screen work, then use its display monitor to keep the group focused on one source at a time.
cards.short_summary: Bookable collaborative rooms with large display monitors.
cards.evidence_claim: NJIT documents group study rooms with large display monitors for collaborative work in the NJIT Library.
cards.access_notes: Room availability and booking requirements can change; use the library’s Group Study Rooms link to review current rules.

cards.title: Leir Data Observatory
cards.subtitle: Robert W. Van Houten Library, Central Avenue Building
cards.notes: Bring a data-heavy assignment or visualization question and use this dedicated setting for focused data-science study with classmates or faculty.
cards.short_summary: A high-tech library setting dedicated to data-science study.
cards.evidence_claim: NJIT describes the Leir Data Observatory as a dedicated high-tech space for students and faculty to study data science.
cards.access_notes: Located in Van Houten Library; confirm current access, programming, and equipment availability with the library.

cards.entity_name: Barbara and Leonard Littman Architecture & Design Library
cards.title: Littman Architecture & Design Library
cards.subtitle: Weston Hall
cards.notes: Set up with architecture, art, or design research materials nearby; use the branch library when your work benefits from drawings, maps, models, or journals.
cards.short_summary: NJIT’s branch library for architecture, art, and design research.
cards.evidence_claim: NJIT states that Littman Library in Weston Hall maintains digital and physical architecture, art, and design resources, including maps, drawings, media, and models.
cards.access_notes: Check the Littman Library’s current hours and any collection-use requirements before planning a session.

cards.title: Digital Scholarship Lab
cards.subtitle: Littman Architecture & Design Library, Weston Hall
cards.notes: Use this named lab when a design or humanities project needs digital methods; verify current lab access and available tools before building your workflow.
cards.short_summary: A digital-work setting within NJIT’s architecture and design library.
cards.evidence_claim: NJIT lists the Digital Scholarship Lab as a space housed in the Littman Architecture & Design Library.
cards.access_notes: Located in Littman Library; contact the library to confirm current access and whether specialized equipment requires assistance.

cards.title: Mostoller Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Littman Architecture & Design Library, Weston Hall
cards.notes: Plan a reading-and-notes session near architecture and design holdings; check with library staff if you need guidance using nearby special-format materials.
cards.short_summary: A named reading room inside the Littman Architecture & Design Library.
cards.evidence_claim: NJIT lists the Mostoller Reading Room among the spaces housed in Littman Architecture & Design Library.
cards.access_notes: Located in Littman Library; check current opening hours and any reading-room procedures with library staff.

cards.title: Materials Library
cards.subtitle: Littman Architecture & Design Library, Weston Hall
cards.notes: Pair research notes with material samples when developing a design concept; ask library staff about handling or consulting samples in the collection.
cards.short_summary: A sample-based research setting for material-focused design study.
cards.evidence_claim: NJIT identifies the Materials Library in Littman Library as a collection of material samples.
cards.access_notes: Located in Littman Library; confirm current access and handling procedures for material samples before visiting.

cards.entity_name: Kennedy Honors Center Quiet Study Room
cards.title: Kennedy Honors Center Quiet Study Room
cards.subtitle: Kennedy Honors Center
cards.notes: Choose a private carrel for concentrated reading or a table for a small working session; keep the room orderly so both formats remain usable.
cards.short_summary: A quiet Honors Center room with private carrels and tables.
cards.evidence_claim: NJIT states that the Kennedy Honors Center’s quiet study room supports individual and group study with private carrels and tables.
cards.source_title: The Kennedy Honors Center | Albert Dorman Honors College
cards.access_notes: This space is in the Kennedy Honors Center; confirm current eligibility and access procedures with the Albert Dorman Honors College.

cards.title: Kennedy Honors Center Computer Lab
cards.subtitle: Kennedy Honors Center
cards.notes: Use the computer lab for coursework that needs campus-connected hardware, software, or printing; confirm availability before relying on a specific workstation.
cards.short_summary: A computer-based study setting within the Kennedy Honors Center.
cards.evidence_claim: NJIT states that the Kennedy Honors Center computer facility includes current computer hardware, software, laser printers, peripherals, and Ethernet connectivity.
cards.source_title: The Kennedy Honors Center | Albert Dorman Honors College
cards.access_notes: This space is in the Kennedy Honors Center; confirm current eligibility, operating hours, and printer access with the Albert Dorman Honors College.
